title: Release comms & migration template for LTS / rolling upgrade channels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: produce a set of customer-facing artifacts to accompany the runtime-1.20 release window. Deliverables: (1) canonical release notes / changelog with clear scope by channel (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), (2) migration guide focused on breaking changes and recommended upgrade path for LTS and rolling channels, (3) email + in-console comms templates for customers on Dedicated and Private, (4) ops runbook snippets for on-call to execute rollback and gating, (5) a short one-page FAQ for account teams and Solutions Engineers. Goals: reduce customer confusion during upgrades, shorten time-to-upgrade for Dedicated/Private customers, and provide transparent deprecation windows for API/feature changes. Scope notes: do not include internal-only rollout telemetry; link to anonymized dashboards. Include specific guidance for API versioning (Accept-Version header, SDK pinning), model variant fallbacks, and data migration steps if any configuration format changes. This ticket produces artifacts; implementation of server-side gates (traffic split) is tracked in ENG-7288.
acceptance_criteria: Published release notes markdown in docs repo and linked from Console release card
Migration guide includes step-by-step instructions with example curl/SDK snippets for Hosted/Dedicated/Private
Comms templates for three audiences: general Hosted users, Dedicated admins, Private/VPC operators
Rollout gate thresholds and rollback steps documented and validated with SRE
Stakeholder review completed: PM, Solutions Eng, Legal (if required), and Security
rollout_plan_summary: Primary channel: rolling (hosted) with staged traffic gates: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours assuming SLOs hold. LTS channel: scheduled upgrade for eligible clusters with a 30-day migration window and opt-in canary 10% for dedicated customers. Gate triggers: token error rate > 1.5x baseline, 95th latency > SLA + 50ms, or regression in end-to-end quality checks. On open regressions, pause rollout and trigger rollback plan.
migration_steps_outline: Step 1: Pin client to runtime-1.20 SDK (or use Accept-Version header). Provide examples for Python/Go/JS.
Step 2: Validate model compatibility: confirm pinned model variant or fallback mapping in config.yml
Step 3: Run pre-upgrade test suite (local evals + production shadow traffic on 0.1% for 24h)
Step 4: Apply config changes to Dedicated pools using the orchestration API; for Private, follow on-prem upgrade doc and coordinate maintenance window
Step 5: Monitor rollouts at each gate; if thresholds exceeded, execute rollback steps from Runbook
Step 6: Post-upgrade checklist: re-run evaluation prompts, confirm cost profile and token billing metrics, and close migration ticket
comms_templates:
Hosted Subject: Redwood runtime-1.20: feature update and no-action required improvements
Hosted Body: Hello — we're rolling out runtime-1.20 to Hosted customers over the next 48 hours. No action is required for most users. This release improves batching efficiency and reduces median latency for chat endpoints. If you rely on a pinned model version, see the migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/runtime-1.20. Rollback: If you experience issues, contact support@redwood.ai and include your request-id and region.

Dedicated Subject: Upcoming upgrade: runtime-1.20 scheduled upgrade window
Dedicated Body: Hi — we plan to apply runtime-1.20 to reserved Dedicated pools between 2026-03-25 and 2026-03-27. This is an opt-in scheduled upgrade for Dedicated customers. If you want the canary (10%), reply to this message to opt in. Required action: review migration checklist and pin client SDK if you use Accept-Version. Full migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/migrate-1.20. Contact your account team for custom timing.

Private Subject: On-prem / VPC upgrade guidance for runtime-1.20
Private Body: Dear Operator — runtime-1.20 contains configuration changes to the deployment manifest (kv_cache.enabled default toggled). Before upgrading, ensure you have a tested backup of your inference-config and KMS keys. Follow: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/upgrade-1.20. For air-gapped installs, coordinate with Support at support@redwood.ai for the offline bundle and a pre-upgrade checklist.
